day: Use case: historical-scene. Create a finished landscape background illustration for an 800x480 touchscreen (5:3 aspect ratio), no text, no UI, no borders. Serene Edo-period Japanese mountainside onsen, beautifully painted with subtle woodblock print influence, delicate ink linework and atmospheric layered mountains. A lone ronin wearing a deep woven fukaamigasa straw hat stands quietly in the left third beside a rustic wooden fence, indigo travel robes, sword at his side. Steam rises from stone hot-spring pools, a small traditional wooden bathhouse nestled among pines in the middle distance, misty mountains and soft dawn light. Elegant restrained colors, pale warm sky, moss and muted blue-green mountain silhouettes, fine natural textures without excessive visual noise. Keep upper right and lower right areas visually calm for resource-reading overlays added later. The figure must be clearly legible at small display size. No other people, no modern objects. Full bleed scene, consistent grounded perspective. This is the DAY state; a matching sleeping NIGHT state will follow.
hat: Edit this illustration only: replace the ronin's shallow conical straw hat with the requested FUKAAMIGASA, a deep woven basket-like straw hat worn low over the head, enclosing and obscuring the face, characteristic deep komuso-style tengai silhouette. Keep the entire landscape, sunrise, character position, indigo robes, sword, onsen, fence, colors, framing and painting style exactly unchanged. No text or UI.
sakura: Edit this day illustration: add beautiful flowering sakura cherry trees along the left edge and around the onsen, gracefully arching pink-blossom branches, a few pale petals on the path. Preserve the standing ronin with deep face-covering basket fukaamigasa, his indigo robes, sword, fence, exact landscape composition, dawn lighting and beautiful painted woodblock style. Keep right third calm for dashboard overlays. No text or interface. Landscape 5:3.
night: Create the matching NIGHT state by editing this exact illustration. Keep camera, mountains, onsen pools, bathhouse, sakura trees and fence precisely aligned with the original. Same beautiful woodblock-painted style. Moonlit deep indigo evening, softly glowing warm bathhouse windows, pale pink cherry blossoms still visible, calm mist.
